name: cuporacle-mcp

tools.name: wc_fixtures
tools.description: List FIFA World Cup 2026 fixtures. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for that day, or omit to get the next upcoming matches (soonest first). Free.

date.description: Optional day filter (UTC), e.g. 2026-07-14. Omit for the next upcoming fixtures.

tools.name: wc_live
tools.description: Live score, minute and status for one World Cup match by id. Reflects half-time / full-time / in-play state. Free.

tools.name: wc_odds
tools.description: Consensus head-to-head odds (mean decimal price across books) and de-vigged implied probabilities for one match. Free. Odds appear only once both teams are known.

tools.name: wc_bracket
tools.description: Current knockout bracket state (Round of 16 → Final) with scores and winners where known. Free.

tools.name: wc_edge
tools.description: Buy a CLV-audited edge + conviction ladder for one match from LineLock. The agent pays ~0.05 USDC ITSELF via x402 (spend-capped) and returns the edge plus the on-chain receipt tx to cite. Degrades to free odds if the upstream is down; never fabricates an edge or receipt. Use dry_run:true to prove the quote-parse + spend-cap path without paying.

maxSpend.description: Per-call USDC ceiling for this purchase (e.g. 0.05). Never exceeds the session cap.

dry_run.description: If true, parse the recorded 402 quote and enforce the spend cap WITHOUT paying (proof path). No receipt is produced. Default false (attempts a real, funds-gated purchase).

tools.name: receipt_verify
tools.description: Verify an x402 USDC payment receipt on Injective EVM: reads the tx over RPC, decodes the USDC transfer, and returns block time, amount, payer and payee with an explorer link. Free.

txHash.description: The receipt transaction hash to verify.

tools.name: wallet_fund_guide
tools.description: Return a CCTP runbook to move USDC from Base/Arbitrum/Ethereum onto Injective so the agent can pay for wc_edge. Routes the real moves to the InjectiveLabs/mcp-server (account_balances, cctp_supported_chains, cctp_attestation_status, cctp_mint). Free, read-only.

chain.description: Source chain that holds your USDC (default: base).

tools.name: wc_spend_ledger
tools.description: The agent's own purchase history: every wc_edge attempt with amount and receipt tx, plus the session total against the spend cap. Free, read-only — the audit trail for autonomous spend.

instructions: CupOracle adds FIFA World Cup 2026 awareness to your agent: fixtures, live scores, consensus odds, and a paid wc_edge tool that buys a vetted edge via x402 (spend-capped) and cites the on-chain receipt. Always cite receipt_tx when you present a paid edge; verify with receipt_verify.
